title: Scalar restriction respects the tensor-to-literal open restriction model
statement: Let A and B be finite commutative rings, let φ:A→B be a ring homomorphism, and let j:X→Z be an open immersion of schemes with small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Write G_A and P_A for the native constant-ring module inverse and direct images, and Res_W for restriction along φ on W [lem-weil-proetale-direct-image-restriction-of-scalars]. Define d:P_B⋙Res_Z ≅ Res_X⋙P_A by the section-normalized finite-coefficient direct-image comparison [lem-weil-proetale-direct-image-restriction-of-scalars], conjugated by compactSupportDirectModel [def-weil-compact-support-native-system-evaluation], and g:Res_Z⋙G_A → G_B⋙Res_X as its inverse adjunction mate. Write K_A for literal restriction to the open in the canonical intrinsic realization coordinates [lem-weil-extension-by-zero-adjunction]. Let β_A:G_A≅K_A be openSquarePullbackModel [lem-trf-open-square-exchange] followed by the transported upperStarIsoOpenImmersionRestriction, and similarly β_B. Let σ:Res_Z⋙K_A≅K_B⋙Res_X be sfOpenRestrictionCoefficientSquare [lem-sf-open-extension-scalar-restriction-coherence]. For every B-module sheaf N on Z, g_N ≫ Res_X(β_B,N) = β_A,Res_Z(N) ≫ σ_N. No surjectivity or flatness of φ is required.

source.place: Tag 03D3, adjoint inverse and direct images of modules; Tag 03CY, restriction to a localized site; Tag 03DI, lemma-extension-by-zero. The coordinate-normalization part of step 2 of lem-weil-compact-support-ordinary-open-transition.

proof.text: On every scalar-unit section, sfRealizationRestriction is the identity and sfIntrinsicDirectImageComparison sends the source scalar-unit section to the target scalar-unit section. The scalar-unit map is an isomorphism on sections (the underlying presheaf is already a sheaf), so these normalizations prove scalarDirectRealization on all sections. Cancel the realization and direct-image isomorphisms to obtain scalarDirectRealization_inv.

Define literalUnit as the realization counit inverse, followed by realization of the fixed-scalar literal restriction unit, followed by the inverse normalized direct-image comparison. The formula for sfInverseRealizationRestriction, naturality of the realization counit, and its triangle identity give inverseRealization_counit. Fixed-scalar restriction commutes literally with the open restriction adjunction unit. Use that equality, naturality of sfRealizationRestriction, and scalarDirectRealization_inv to prove literalUnit_scalar.

Expand the unit of an adjunction transported through two equivalences and the normalized direct-image comparison; naturality of that comparison and the realization triangle identity give realizedAdjunction_unit. The unit equation for the canonical leftAdjointUniq from fixed-scalar upperStar to literal restriction then proves upperModel_direct_unit. Combine it sectionwise with openSquarePullbackModel_existsUnique to obtain native_literal_unit for the published compactSupportOpenRestrictionModel.

Apply the tensor inverse-image/direct-image Hom equivalence and use its injectivity. The inverse-mate unit identity expresses the transpose of compactSupportScalarPullback using compactSupportScalarDirectImage, whose action on sections is the identity. Apply native_literal_unit to both sides and literalUnit_scalar to identify the two transposes. Sectionwise extensionality closes their equality. All maps and arguments apply unchanged to zero rings, identity coefficient maps, and empty opens.

from.place: Step 2: transport of the scalar square to the native restriction model.

lean.statement:
theorem compactSupportOpenRestrictionModel_scalar {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (φ : A →+* B) (N : proEtaleRingModules Z (proEtaleConstantRing Z B)) :
    (compactSupportScalarPullback j φ).app N ≫
      (proEtaleCoefficientRestrictScalars X φ).map
        ((compactSupportOpenRestrictionModel B j).hom.app N) =
    (compactSupportOpenRestrictionModel A j).hom.app
        ((proEtaleCoefficientRestrictScalars Z φ).obj N) ≫
      (sfOpenRestrictionCoefficientSquare j φ).hom.app N
